intro.title: Luxury travel, coordinated through one trusted point of contact.
intro.body: Total Stay Tours is a London-based luxury travel company with over a decade of experience in the travel industry, having been established in 2014. We specialise in creating bespoke travel experiences for discerning travellers from the GCC and beyond, with a strong focus on Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and other international markets. We go beyond traditional travel arrangements, bringing together luxury hotels and residences, private jet and helicopter charters, yacht experiences, VIP airport services, chauffeur-driven transfers and personalised concierge services.
paragraphs: Total Stay Tours is a London-based luxury travel company with over a decade of experience in the travel industry, having been established in 2014.
We specialise in creating bespoke travel experiences for discerning travellers from the GCC and beyond, with a strong focus on Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and other international markets.

We go beyond traditional travel arrangements, bringing together luxury hotels and residences, private jet and helicopter charters, yacht experiences, VIP airport services, chauffeur-driven transfers and personalised concierge services.

Since 2014, we have built a trusted network of hotels, aviation companies, yacht operators, chauffeurs and luxury service providers, allowing us to coordinate every element of a journey through one trusted point of contact.

We understand that luxury travel is personal. That is why we take the time to understand each client's preferences and requirements, creating seamless, tailor-made experiences designed around their lifestyle.

Whether you are planning a family holiday in London, a private jet journey across Europe, a yacht charter in the South of France, or a complete luxury itinerary, Total Stay Tours is here to take care of every detail.

paragraphs: At Total Stay Tours, we provide a complete range of luxury travel services, carefully tailored to meet the needs of discerning travellers from the GCC and beyond.

groups.title: Bespoke Travel Planning
closing: From a luxury weekend in London to a fully customised European journey, we coordinate every detail of your trip through one trusted point of contact.
One company. One point of contact. Every detail taken care of.

clientSections.title: Private Aviation
paragraphs: Through our trusted network of established aviation partners, Total Stay Tours provides access to a wide selection of private aircraft, from light and midsize jets to super-midsize and long-range aircraft, as well as private helicopters.

We carefully source each aircraft based on your destination, schedule, number of passengers and specific requirements, while focusing on competitive rates and value without compromising on quality or service.
closing: Whether you require a private jet for a European getaway, a helicopter transfer between destinations, or a fully customised multi-leg journey, our team compares suitable options to help secure competitive pricing and the right aircraft for your journey.
Exceptional aircraft. Competitive rates. Personalised service.

clientSections.title: Yacht Charters
paragraphs: At Total Stay Tours, we arrange bespoke yacht charter experiences across some of the most sought-after destinations in the Mediterranean and beyond.

Through our trusted network of yacht partners, we provide access to a carefully selected range of luxury yachts, from elegant day boats to spacious motor yachts, suitable for private day trips, family holidays, celebrations and multi-day charters.

We focus on finding the right yacht at a competitive rate, while maintaining high standards of quality, comfort and service. Our team compares suitable options based on your preferred destination, dates, number of guests, itinerary and onboard requirements to help secure the best available value.
closing: From a relaxing day cruising along the French Riviera to a fully customised multi-day Mediterranean itinerary, our team coordinates the yacht, itinerary and additional arrangements around your requirements.
Luxury yachts. Competitive rates. Unforgettable experiences.

faqs.question: What does Total Stay Tours arrange?
faqs.answer: We arrange luxury hotels and residences, private jet and helicopter charters, yacht experiences, VIP airport services, chauffeur-driven transfers and personalised concierge services.

faqs.question: Do you work with GCC clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialise in bespoke travel experiences for discerning travellers from the GCC and beyond, with a strong focus on Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar.

faqs.question: Can you arrange hotels in London and Europe?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with leading hotels and luxury serviced residences in London and across Europe, with exclusive or preferred rates and added benefits subject to availability. Whether you are travelling with family, planning a business trip or looking for a luxurious long stay in London, our team can recommend and arrange the right property based on your preferences and requirements.

faqs.question: Can you source a private jet or helicopter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Through trusted aviation partners, we source suitable aircraft based on destination, schedule, passenger count and specific journey requirements. Whether you require a private jet for a European getaway, a helicopter transfer between destinations, or a fully customised multi-leg journey, our team compares suitable options to help secure competitive pricing and the right aircraft for your journey.

faqs.question: Can you arrange yacht charters in the South of France?
faqs.answer: Yes. We arrange yacht charters in Cannes, Monaco, St Tropez and across the Mediterranean, including day charters, multi-day charters, onboard catering and bespoke itineraries. We focus on finding the right yacht at a competitive rate, while maintaining high standards of quality, comfort and service.
